name: phd-mscse-transfer-funding-clock
description: DGS Handbook §4.1 (“Students progressing from a master’s degree to a Ph.D. degree within the same program will not have their funding eligibility reset”) — policy review 2026-10-04, P2-dh-4-5-3; DGS: “Apply the suggested handling”. A student who started the CSE MSCSE in Fall 2022 and transferred into the Ph.D. without finishing it: the eight-year row now says funding years count from Fall 2022 too, as the degree clocks do.

detailIncludes: does not reset funding eligibility (DGS Handbook §4.1), so your funding years count from Fall 2022, when you started the MSCSE
